Data Deletion Instructions

You can ask PageCrew to delete all data we hold about you at any time.

Option 1: Remove the app from Facebook

  1. Go to Facebook > Settings & privacy > Settings.
  2. Open Business Integrations.
  3. Find PageCrew (Social Pilot) and click Remove.

Option 2: Email us

Send an email to YOUR_EMAIL@example.com with the subject "Delete my data" from the address linked to your account, and include your Facebook name. We will delete your profile information, Page access tokens and saved posts within 30 days and confirm by email.

See our Privacy Policy for details.
